basic_info.description: Bernal Heights Victorian Gem. Nestled in one of San Francisco's most desirable locations, this charming Victorian is just steps from the shops, cafs, and conveniences of Cortland Avenueperfectly suited for the vibrant Bernal Heights lifestyle. The spacious main level showcases the timeless character of the era with soaring ceilings, detailed moldings, and a flexible floor plan. Here you'll find 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, a welcoming living room, dining room, and a large kitchen that opens to a sunny deck and whimsical garden patioideal for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. The basement level offers abundant storage, laundry, and a 1-car garage, with plenty of room to explore expansion potential. Blending period charm with opportunity for personalization, this home is a rare chance to create your dream space in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods. Don't miss it - opportunity awaits at the heart of Bernal Heights.
